categories_scope.name: categories_scope
categories_scope.value: ("categories"."pool_id" is null and "categories"."system_key" is not null and "categories"."name" is null) or ("categories"."pool_id" is not null and "categories"."name" is not null and "categories"."system_key" is null)

categories_name_len.name: categories_name_len
categories_name_len.value: "categories"."name" is null or char_length("categories"."name") between 1 and 60

deposits_pay_period.name: deposits_pay_period
deposits_pay_period.value: ("deposits"."pay_n" is null) = ("deposits"."pay_u" is null) and ("deposits"."pay_n" is null or ("deposits"."pay_n" between 1 and 3650 and "deposits"."pay_u" in ('m', 'd')))

deposits_term.name: deposits_term
deposits_term.value: ("deposits"."term_n" is null) = ("deposits"."term_u" is null) and ("deposits"."term_n" is null or ("deposits"."term_n" between 1 and 3650 and "deposits"."term_u" in ('m', 'd')))

goal_scopes_one_kind.name: goal_scopes_one_kind
goal_scopes_one_kind.value:
("goal_scopes"."portfolio_id" is not null and "goal_scopes"."account_id" is null and "goal_scopes"."sub_account_id" is null)
        or ("goal_scopes"."portfolio_id" is null and "goal_scopes"."account_id" is not null)

investment_ops_trade_fields.name: investment_ops_trade_fields
investment_ops_trade_fields.value: "investment_ops"."type" not in ('buy', 'sell') or (coalesce("investment_ops"."qty" > 0, false) and coalesce("investment_ops"."price" >= 0, false))

investment_ops_sub_needs_account.name: investment_ops_sub_needs_account
investment_ops_sub_needs_account.value: "investment_ops"."sub_account_id" is null or "investment_ops"."account_id" is not null

investment_ops_ext_id_len.name: investment_ops_ext_id_len
investment_ops_ext_id_len.value: "investment_ops"."ext_id" is null or char_length("investment_ops"."ext_id") between 1 and 120

loan_installments_amounts_not_negative.name: loan_installments_amounts_not_negative
loan_installments_amounts_not_negative.value:
"loan_installments"."capital" >= 0 and "loan_installments"."interest" >= 0 and "loan_installments"."fees" >= 0
        and "loan_installments"."stamp_tax" >= 0 and "loan_installments"."life_insurance" >= 0
        and "loan_installments"."home_insurance" >= 0 and "loan_installments"."credit_insurance" >= 0

plans_sub_needs_account.name: plans_sub_needs_account
plans_sub_needs_account.value: "plans"."sub_account_id" is null or "plans"."account_id" is not null

properties_address_len.name: properties_address_len
properties_address_len.value: "properties"."address" is null or char_length("properties"."address") between 1 and 200

savings_products_pay_period.name: savings_products_pay_period
savings_products_pay_period.value: ("savings_products"."pay_n" is null) = ("savings_products"."pay_u" is null) and ("savings_products"."pay_n" is null or ("savings_products"."pay_n" between 1 and 3650 and "savings_products"."pay_u" in ('m', 'd')))

savings_products_term.name: savings_products_term
savings_products_term.value: ("savings_products"."term_n" is null) = ("savings_products"."term_u" is null) and ("savings_products"."term_n" is null or ("savings_products"."term_n" between 1 and 3650 and "savings_products"."term_u" in ('m', 'd')))

loan_events_prepayment_shape.name: loan_events_prepayment_shape
loan_events_prepayment_shape.value:
"loan_events"."kind" <> 'prepayment' or ("loan_events"."amount" > 0
        and "loan_events"."effect" in ('reduce_installment', 'reduce_term')
        and "loan_events"."annual_rate" is null and "loan_events"."term_months" is null) is true

loan_events_prepayment_only_fields.name: loan_events_prepayment_only_fields
loan_events_prepayment_only_fields.value: "loan_events"."kind" = 'prepayment' or ("loan_events"."amount" is null and "loan_events"."fee" is null and "loan_events"."effect" is null)

loan_events_review_shape.name: loan_events_review_shape
loan_events_review_shape.value: "loan_events"."kind" <> 'rate_review' or ("loan_events"."annual_rate" is not null and "loan_events"."term_months" is null)

loan_events_renegotiation_shape.name: loan_events_renegotiation_shape
loan_events_renegotiation_shape.value: "loan_events"."kind" <> 'renegotiation' or "loan_events"."annual_rate" is not null or "loan_events"."term_months" is not null

loan_events_rate_range.name: loan_events_rate_range
loan_events_rate_range.value:
("loan_events"."annual_rate" is null or "loan_events"."annual_rate" between 0 and 100)
        and ("loan_events"."index_value" is null or "loan_events"."index_value" between -10 and 100)
        and ("loan_events"."spread" is null or "loan_events"."spread" between -10 and 100)

works_projects_supplier_len.name: works_projects_supplier_len
works_projects_supplier_len.value: "works_projects"."supplier" is null or char_length("works_projects"."supplier") between 1 and 80

works_projects_dates_in_order.name: works_projects_dates_in_order
works_projects_dates_in_order.value: "works_projects"."start_date" is null or "works_projects"."planned_end" is null or "works_projects"."planned_end" >= "works_projects"."start_date"
